caption: MCP Elicit Request Url Params
description: The parameters for a request to elicit information from the user via a URL in the client. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 ElicitRequestURLParams; 2026-07-28 ElicitRequestURLParams).
name: mcp_elicit_request_url_params

mcp_elicit_request_url_params__meta.description: MCP member `_meta`: See [General fields: `_meta`](/specification/2025-11-25/basic/index#meta) for notes on `_meta` usage.

mcp_elicitation_id.description:
MCP member `elicitationId` (required by the protocol): The ID of the elicitation, which must be unique within the context of the server.
The client MUST treat this ID as an opaque value.

mcp_message.description: MCP member `message` (required by the protocol): The message to present to the user explaining why the interaction is needed.

mcp_mode.description: MCP member `mode` (required by the protocol): The elicitation mode.

mcp_task_metadata.description:
MCP member `task`: If specified, the caller is requesting task-augmented execution for this request.
The request will return a CreateTaskResult immediately, and the actual result can be
retrieved later via tasks/result.

Task augmentation is subject to capability negotiation - receivers MUST declare support
for task augmentation of specific request types in their capabilities.

mcp_url_string.description: MCP member `url` (required by the protocol): The URL that the user should navigate to.

mcp_additional_members.description: Members the pinned definition does not name, exactly as reported, in source order.

mcp_nonconforming_members.description: Named members whose value does not fit the pinned definition, exactly as reported.
